Repo: /opt/nxeon (Next.js/TypeScript/Prisma/Postgres hosting platform, production, admin project board at /admin/board). Work in an isolated git worktree for any code changes — `git worktree add /opt/nxeon-wip-board-ideas -b fix/board-new-ideas` from /opt/nxeon — do NOT touch the live /opt/nxeon tree or merge into main for code changes. Symlink node_modules and .env; never `git add -A` in a worktree. Database writes (moving board cards between stages) should go directly against the real database via a script using `lib/db.ts` — that's normal operational data, not code, and doesn't need the worktree isolation the code changes do.

## What you're doing

Nxeon has its own internal admin kanban board (`/admin/board`, backed by real DB tables — check `prisma/schema.prisma` for the Board/Card/Stage models, likely named something like `BoardCard`/`BoardColumn` or similar — grep the schema). There are exactly 5 cards sitting in the **"New Ideas"** stage/column right now:
1. "Remove these from homepage" — feature tag, 2 attachments
2. "Home page edit" — feature tag, 1 attachment, added most recently ("just now")
3. "Home Page Edit" — feature tag, 1 attachment, ~57m old
4. "Home page edit" — feature tag, 1 attachment, ~57m old
5. "Home page edit" — feature tag, 1 attachment, ~57m old

Your job: process ONLY the cards currently in the "New Ideas" stage (do not touch cards in any other stage/column). For each one:

1. Read the card's full title, description/body text, and attachments from the database and disk. Board attachments live on disk at `/opt/nxeon/board-uploads/board/<cardId>/<contentHash>.<ext>` (confirmed pattern from earlier sessions) — find the exact card IDs first (query the DB for cards where stage/column name matches "New Ideas", case-insensitive), then look up their attachment files in that directory structure. If images, read them with the Read tool to see what's actually being pointed at/annotated — these are very likely screenshots with markup/arrows showing exactly what homepage element to change.

2. **Do not assume the 4 "Home page edit" cards are duplicates just because they share a title.** Each one may have a DIFFERENT attachment pointing at a different part of the homepage, or genuinely be near-duplicate requests (possibly the same person submitting multiple times, or from different reviewers). Open every single one and determine what it's actually asking for before deciding anything. If two turn out to be genuinely identical requests, say so explicitly in your report rather than silently merging or ignoring one.

3. **Implement each requested change** to the live marketing homepage. The homepage code is most likely under `app/page.tsx` and/or `app/(marketing)/**` and `components/marketing/**` — find the actual homepage route yourself (check for a root `app/page.tsx` that renders the public marketing site, given `/dashboard` and `/admin` are separate authenticated sections). Match the existing code's style and this repo's established design language (dark navy/violet/cyan brand — do not introduce a different visual style). If a card's request is genuinely ambiguous even after reading its full content and attachment, implement your best-faith reasonable interpretation and flag your reasoning clearly in your report rather than leaving it undone — but if a card is asking for something that seems actively wrong or harmful to implement as literally stated, flag it instead of blindly executing.

4. **After implementing a card's change**, move that card to whatever stage represents "done"/"completed" in this board's actual stage list (query the DB to see the real stage names available — don't guess, e.g. it might be "Done", "Shipped", "In Review", etc.) — mirroring how this board is normally operated (cards move through stages as work progresses). If you're not confident a change is fully correct/complete, move it to whatever the "in progress" or "needs review" equivalent stage is instead of "done" — use your judgment, but state clearly in your report which stage you moved each card to and why.

## What NOT to do

- Do not touch cards in any OTHER board stage — only "New Ideas".
- Do not touch custom-server-plans, PayPal, or Namecheap/registrar code — separate agents in parallel, unrelated to a homepage-copy/layout task anyway.
- Do not deploy/promote anything to staging or production yourself — I will review your diff and ship it through the normal pipeline.

## Verification

1. `npx tsc --noEmit` clean.
2. `npm test` — no new failures beyond the current 34 pre-existing baseline (all pricing/proration/auth-related, unrelated to homepage work).
3. If this repo has a way to preview the built page locally (check for a dev server / existing screenshot tooling used in past sessions), use it to sanity-check your visual changes actually look right before calling them done — if no such tooling is available to you, say so plainly in your report rather than claiming visual verification you didn't do.

## Report format

For each of the 5 cards: card ID, exact request (quote or closely paraphrase its actual content/attachment), what you implemented (file:line), which stage you moved it to and why, and your confidence level. Then overall: files modified, verification results, worktree path/branch name.
